results.rationale: Consistency: The red can, large white script and silver rims remain recognizable; the small 'SINCE ... 1886' lettering and lower-left volume marking are altered, and the condensation pattern is redrawn. Requested background, lighting and poster composition changes are excluded. Instruction: The plain backdrop becomes a blue sunlit water-and-ice burst around a close-up central can. A complete result should also display 'Refresh Every Moment' in red/white contrast at the top or center with rising bubbles; the slogan is entirely absent and distinct rising bubbles are not evident, so compliance is partial. Quality, assessed only on this edit: Structure and splash layout are coherent, with crisp ice and droplets; the small lettering flanking CLASSIC is visibly malformed, a clear text artifact.

Consistency: The red can and broad Coca-Cola script remain, but the small upper label lettering, bottom volume text and condensation distribution visibly change. Requested scene and composition changes are excluded. Instruction: Water splashes and scattered ice now surround a close-up central can beneath a large red headline. The expected poster should have the exact 'Refresh Every Moment' slogan with red/white contrast and rising bubbles; the headline is nonsensical and the bubble component is unclear, giving partial compliance. Quality, assessed only on this edit: The can and water have plausible overall forms, but the prominent headline contains garbled words and overlapping ghost text, and small package lettering is corrupted; these multiple distracting text errors degrade the poster.

The slogan addition and new water, ice, bubbles, sunlight and framing are requested changes and excluded. The expected exact red/white slogan 'Refresh Every Moment' instead reads 'REFRESH MOMENT' in white against the red can; the missing 'Every' is a minor omission. Quality, assessed only on this edit: The can, lettering, ice and bubbles are coherent and readable with consistent illumination; the broad foreground splash looks slightly milky and sheet-like, a small naturalness issue.

Consistency: The red can shape, white brand script, CLASSIC/1886 marking and visible condensation retain the source appearance. Requested slogan, lighting, water, ice, bubbles and reframing are excluded from consistency. The expected exact slogan is 'Refresh Every Moment'; the visible red/white treatment instead says 'REFRESH MOMENT' on the upper can, omitting 'Every', so there is a minor omission.
